name: Lystonosha Evie z kovcheha Avora
source:
Many years ago, a catastrophe befell humanity, which drove the survivors into the walls of the arks. Avora is one of them. But life did not stop there, and little Evie, who with her curiosity and lively mind daily gives the residents of Avora faith in the future, never gets tired of proving it.

[Translated from [url=https://annahorak.itch.io/postman-evie]itch.io[/url]]
